summary_en: Koukandekirukun acquired 166,600 shares at ¥900 per share on November 20, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3, representing 2.23% of outstanding shares, for a total of ¥149.94 million. The controlling shareholder participated in the sale.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 19, 2026, the board of Koukandekirukun resolved to acquire treasury stock via ToSTNeT-3. The company executed the purchase on November 20, 2026, acquiring 166,600 shares at ¥900 per share, representing 2.23% of the 7,470,300 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a total outlay of ¥149.94 million. The fixed price of ¥900 was the closing price on the trading day immediately preceding the acquisition.

The controlling shareholder, Board Chairman Masashi Kurihara, who holds more than half of voting rights either directly or through controlled entities, indicated his intention to offer shares in the sale. To address potential conflicts of interest, Kurihara recused himself from board deliberation and voting. The acquisition was approved unanimously by the remaining directors. The company employed ToSTNeT-3 to ensure non-controlling shareholders also had the opportunity to sell, and obtained written opinions from three independent external directors confirming that the transaction purpose is rational, the price is fair and reasonable based on market conditions, and procedures are appropriately structured to protect minority shareholders.

The company stated it intends to use the acquired shares for future M&A consideration or as a source for share-based compensation, though specific application methods and timing remain undetermined. The acquisition was motivated by improving capital efficiency and implementing flexible capital policies in response to changing business conditions.
